name: SBI Shinsei Bank, Limited
summary: SBI Shinsei Bank, Limited provides banking and financial products and services to individual customers, corporations, public-sector entities, and financial institutions in Japan. The company offers retail banking, home mortgages, investment trust, consumer finance, unsecured personal loans, shopping credit and credit cards, loans secured by real estate, fundraising services, corporate and syndicated loans, acquisition and ship finance, healthcare finance, renewable energy finance, finance for start-ups, private equity, real estate non-recourse finance, and project finance services.
